steps.description:
**[W-S-01] Yuri's Level 1 Fusions**
- Enough **Soul Energy** needs to be acquired to accumulate the rest of **Yuri**'s level 1 **Fusions**.
- Luckily, we can revisit a dungeon that has all we need.

**[W-S-02] Kowloon Fortress**
- What happened to **Wugui**?
- As long as you answered the prompts correctly as **Alice** in **Kuihai Tower**, you can go to **Kowloon Fortress** to find out.

notes.title: Only time for this quest
notes.text: This is the **only** time that you can do this quest!

steps.description:
**[W-S-03] Mr. Zhen's Pit Fight**
- **Mr. Zhen** has an array of monsters for **Yuri** to fight.
- There is a very memorable prize for him when the **Pit Fight** is completed.
- You'll definitely want it.

notes.title: Last opportunity for this quest
notes.text: This is the **last opportunity** to do this quest!
